knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A general code does not release a room under investigation. Owner agreement does not replace official release.
Objects that may be evidence stay where they are, and the authorised lead is notified.

practicalCriteria: From a fictional release letter, the learner lists the boundaries it names and marks any room outside them as excluded. Pass: every excluded room is listed.
The learner describes the steps for a found object in order. Pass: no-touch, isolate, notify and record are all included.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed release record for a fictional scene
stopWorkCriteria: A potentially relevant object has been found.
